author: Unity
description:
Introducing Unity 7 - built for a faster-moving, more open industry where creators, cross-functional teams, and coding agents can seamlessly collaborate across every stage of the development cycle. Featuring: 

✅ Create faster: Modernized CoreCLR foundation with a near-instant Play Mode and up to 90% faster shader builds.
✅ Collaborate in better ways: New CLI, public API, and free MCP connect teams and coding agents directly to Unity.
✅ Ship sharper graphics: Richer, realistic lighting via Surface Cache GI across all Unity supported devices.
✅ Grow and monetize smarter: Built-in Unity Vector tools, native webshops, and direct-to-consumer IAP to scale efficiently.
✅ No breaking changes: A direct continuation of Unity 6 architecture, offering an upgrade path with zero rebuilding.

Unity 7 will enter early Beta testing in December, with the Full Release scheduled for Q1 2027

🔗 Learn more: https://on.unity.com/Unity7
